cards.title: Assay Validation and Endogenous Analyte Handling
cards.claim: For analytes that are also endogenous molecules, standard validation is complicated. Approaches include Surrogate Matrix, Surrogate Analyte, Background Subtraction, and Standard Addition. For QCs spiked with authentic analyte in matrix containing endogenous analyte, Accuracy (%) = 100 × (measured concentration of the spiked sample - endogenous concentration) / nominal added concentration. For unspiked endogenous QCs, only precision can be determined.
limitations: Endogenous levels may vary by age, gender, race, etc.
Surrogate matrices may differ in recovery/matrix effects
